sources.title: Targeted revision of sales-tax rates and service-tax scope effective 1 July 2025
Company tax rates; displayed years of assessment 2023-2024

regimes.name: Sales tax on manufacture or import
regimes.applicability: Taxable goods at the manufacturer/import stage; this is not a general retail VAT.
conditions: Determine manufacturer/importer status, tariff code and applicable order.
The 2025 revision describes 5% and 10% categories; a product-level rate is unresolved.
No automatic VAT-style input recovery; assess specific relief separately.

regimes.name: Service tax: standard candidate
regimes.applicability: Prescribed taxable services supplied by a registered person; verify the service group.
conditions: A service business is not automatically a prescribed taxable service.
Check group-specific registration thresholds and exclusions.
Food/beverage and other specified exceptions require their own classification.

regimes.name: Service tax: food and beverage candidate
conditions: Verify establishment/service classification, registration and current threshold.
Separate club subscriptions and other services from qualifying food/beverage supplies.

regimes.name: SST exemption or relief classification
regimes.applicability: Only goods/persons/transactions meeting the relevant exemption or relief instrument.
conditions: Record the schedule, approval and end-use conditions where required.
SST exemption is not a VAT/GST zero-rate with automatic input credit.

regimes.name: Business or company income-tax review
regimes.applicability: Entity/year-specific income-tax computation; never a checkout tax.
conditions: Confirm legal form, residence, year of assessment and applicable concessions.
The reviewed company-rate table covers 2023-2024; do not extrapolate its tiers to 2026.

classification_questions: Which charges are meals, takeaway goods, catering, delivery, alcohol, tips or service charges?
How are discounts, deposits, vouchers and refunds treated at the relevant tax point?
Which current F&B service-tax registration rule covers this establishment?
Which receipts are subscriptions, joining fees, donations, facility hire, food or admissions?
What is the club's legal form and which activities are commercial supplies?
Do dining, membership and facility charges fall into different prescribed service groups?
Which individual products are medicines, medical devices, supplements or cosmetics?
Does the business also provide clinical services, manufacture goods or import them?
Does any SST liability arise at import/manufacture, and which medicine/product exemptions are evidenced?
Does the business act as principal, agent, importer, exporter or manufacturer?
Which tariff/product codes and documentary evidence support each treatment?
Is this ordinary resale, or a separately taxable import/manufacturing/service activity?
Are sales on own account, consignment or commission, and is there a manufacturer appointment?
How are rebates, returns, free stock and cross-border transactions documented?
Does an exemption schedule require approval for goods bought for a registered manufacturer?
Which SKU classifications apply to the actual product mix?
Are there bundled goods/services, gift vouchers, used goods or imports?
Is tax embedded in supplier cost rather than separately chargeable on this retail sale?
Are parts, labor, consumables, subcontract work and warranties separately supplied or bundled?
Does the workshop repair, manufacture, import or export goods?
Which current prescribed service group, if any, covers the repair/maintenance work?

open_questions: Review the latest gazetted SST schedules and post-2025 amendments for each selected business; the broad overview is not a tariff database.
Approve F&B, club and workshop service classifications, registration thresholds, tax bases and tax-point exceptions.
Confirm any specific SST deduction, exemption, refund or drawback; do not create a general recoverable-input SST account by analogy to VAT.
Review current IRBM income-tax rules, e-invoice scope and entity framework independently; no income-tax or filing automation is provided.
